title: Technical Program Manager
summary: A technical program manager (TPM) leads large engineering efforts that cut across several teams, making sure the work is planned, dependencies are handled and the launch happens on time. They sit between engineering, product and leadership, and need enough technical depth to discuss architecture and risks with engineers.
dailyDuties: Track progress, dependencies and risks across several engineering teams
Run weekly program reviews and send status updates to leadership
Work with engineers on technical designs and trade-offs
Plan milestones and launch dates with product managers
Remove blockers by escalating to the right owners
Coordinate release readiness with QA, SRE and support teams

skills.expectation: Run programs that span several engineering teams: plans, dependencies, risks and status

Understand system architecture well enough to judge technical trade-offs and risks
Run delivery in Scrum or Kanban teams
Turn priorities into a sequenced roadmap and milestones
Track work, blockers and launches in Jira
